source: Captured in the league owner's own logged-in Chrome, with their consent, from one 34-team NFL dynasty league. League and team ids are placeholders; team names and logo file names are synthetic and only show the shape.

request.note: No token in the body or the headers: the Fantrax login cookie is the only credential. `refUrl` was the page that sent the request. `v` is the site's own version and will change.

logoImage.result: 200 image/webp for both the 128 and the 256 file, fetched with no cookie
logoImage.otherShapeSeenOnThePage: https://fantraximg.com/assets/images/icons/fantasyteams/<sport>/<set>/<file> — Fantrax's stock icons, used by teams with no uploaded logo in other leagues

alsoSeen.getTeamRosterInfo: Sent by a team's roster page. Its response has `settings.logoUploaded`, `settings.logoUrl` and `teamHeadingInfo.owners` (the managers' names). Shape only; values were not captured.

notCaptured: Whether the request is refused when `v` is out of date
Whether a request sent by a browser extension, not the site's own page, is accepted
